title: Home Charging Power Derate Detection
dataSources: Tesla vehicle and charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smart EV charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, TeslaFi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / charger APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=evcharger:session
| stats avg(power_kw) as avg_kw, max(requested_kw) as requested_kw by charger session_id
| where requested_kw>0 AND avg_kw<requested_kw*0.7
| sort avg_kw
description: Compares requested charging power with what the charger actually delivered and surfaces the sessions where something quietly derated your home charging speed.
value: A charge session that drags on for hours often looks normal until you measure it against the expected rate; this query makes cable, breaker, and temperature issues obvious.
implementation: Forward charger session telemetry with requested and delivered kilowatts; alert when effective power is materially below plan.
visualization: Table of sessions with requested versus delivered charging power.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks when your home charger is giving the car much less power than it should and charging is taking longer than expected.
